single_compatibility_change.reason: The selected SM120 FlashInfer sparse-MLA backend is the already-used GLM fp8_ds_mla path and explicitly requires the packed fp8_ds_mla layout.

unchanged: P8 and EXL3 model, quantization, capture-image parent, MoE backend, topology, and caches
four windows, forced-token sequences, teacher logits, V2 pre-mask FP32 capture, and KLD implementation
CUDA graphs on, max_num_seqs=1, and MTP off
decision thresholds, storage budget, role boundary, and no-retry policy
causal_boundary: Because the original B12X backend cannot instantiate the requested FP8 layout for GLM NoPE, v2 is necessarily an FP8-compatible attention-plus-KV-path intervention. It can test whether the approximately 0.11 endpoint persists on the established FP8 serving path, but cannot attribute a change to KV dtype alone.
retry_policy: One fresh v2 execution only; preserve v1 and do not relabel it.
